game.name: Kinect Disneyland Adventures (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Kinect Disneyland Adventures invites you to explore Disney's Californian park and experience 18 legendary attractions (Space Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, etc.) while meeting some thirty famous characters (Mickey, Goofy, Arielle, etc.). In total, 100 mini-games and challenges await players who can experience this adventure alone or in cooperation.
